name: SingletonLifestyle
summary: One instance serves every consumer for the lifetime of the application, created once and never replaced.

reference.author: Steven van Deursen, Mark Seemann
reference.work: Dependency Injection Principles, Practices, and Patterns

roles.name: SingletonLifestyle
roles.summary: A class of which exactly one instance exists. Two things follow and neither is visible in it: it is used concurrently, so it must be thread-safe and hold nothing belonging to one caller; and everything it depends on outlives every consumer, so a shorter-lived dependency reaching it is held long past the life it was given.
